summary: Frontend-only testing of the Stock Transfer (STO) page refactor: shared OrderDetailBody used by both the Recent Orders detail modal and the create-flow confirm dialog, plus the new gi_posted_at 'Posted at:' line. (1) Detail-modal regression on real order STO-000070 (live data): every pre-existing section still renders (Created in SAP box, ERP Portal box, Goods Issue posted box, GST/Transport box, ship-from/to/GST detail grid, items table with 9 columns incl. Ship Status, Print Delivery Note button) with no layout breakage and 0 console errors. (2) gi_posted_at line: no existing order in Mongo has gi_posted_at (all 62 orders predate the change, expected), so it was verified by (a) code inspection of stock_transfer_service.py - all 3 'gi_status':'posted' $set blocks (lines 702, 821, 918) now also set 'gi_posted_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc) - and (b) a route-level response injection in Playwright: with gi_posted_at present the line data-testid=stock-transfer-detail-gi-posted-at renders as 'Posted at: 28 Aug, 06:12:34 pm' in BOTH dialogs. (3) MAIN NEW BEHAVIOR: full create flow driven end-to-end through the real UI (real product search / warehouse / ship-to / GST fields) with only the SAP-write POST + job-status + single-order poll mocked (deliberately NO real SAP write, per instruction to avoid unnecessary live writes). Once the checklist reached 'Create in SAP' done, the confirm dialog rendered the FULL shared body live: success box, ERP box, GI box WITH the new 'Posted at:' line, GST box, detail grid, items table with Ship Status, and the Print Delivery Note button - a line-by-line text diff against the detail modal's body for the same order doc showed ZERO missing lines (identical content). No need to close/reopen the detail modal anymore. (4) Regression: confirm dialog closed cleanly via stock-transfer-confirm-close-button at any time. Backend logs: NO new 'Executable doesn't exist' Playwright errors (latest occurrence 17:29, predates the fix; STO-000070 posted successfully at 17:58 afterwards).

critical_code_review_comments: OrderDetailBody is a clean single source of truth for both dialogs - verified textually identical output for the same order doc. Good.

pollGiStatus stops only the client-side poll (giPollStopRef) on dialog close; the server-side GI job is independent, so closing the dialog does not abort progress (verified by code; existing iteration_133-135 coverage for the job itself).
StockTransferPage.js is 1387 lines - consider extracting OrderDetailBody (and the create form) into separate files per the >700-line guideline.

context_for_next_testing_agent: STO detail modal + confirm dialog now share OrderDetailBody - both verified identical. All existing orders have gi_posted_at=null (pre-change), so to see the 'Posted at:' line live you must either create a real STO or inject gi_posted_at via Playwright route interception on GET https://<base>/api/stock-transfer/orders (NOTE: the list fetch has NO query string, so the route pattern must be the exact URL, not 'orders?**'). Mock recipe used: POST /api/stock-transfer/orders -> {sto_id, sap_job_id}; GET /orders/sap-status/* -> {status:'done', sto_id, result:{sap_order_id}}; GET /orders/{sto_id} -> real STO-000070 doc with gi_posted_at patched in.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect found. First 'FAIL' seen for the gi_posted_at line was a test-side issue: the Playwright route glob '**/api/stock-transfer/orders?**' never matched because loadRecentOrders() calls the endpoint without a query string; after correcting the pattern the line rendered correctly.
